Updated the existing Treasury Bulletin bond-yield skill and memory.

Saved generalizable points:
- Moody’s “highest quality” corporate bonds = Aaa, not Aa.
- “End of World War II” maps to calendar year 1945.
- “Korean War began” maps to calendar year 1950.
- Average annual yield changes should use annual averages and be computed as absolute percentage-point differences, with no division by 100.
